scope: Source re-review of portable installer/runtime, root staging/dispatch/CI helpers, and APK verifier after corrections. Excludes the newly added knowme-builder upgrade journal, semantic version migrations, live external harness behavior and live Windows/Android platform certification. Initial findings remain in runtime-findings.json.
checked_classes: Skills ownership: broad skills add/remove delegation was replaced by individual file copies and digest receipts; preexisting identical files remain unowned and edited owned files block uninstall.
MCP preservation: CLI-managed MCP entries are compared against saved get-output snapshots before removal; unverifiable or changed entries block uninstall.

Requested revisions and source: unsupported Claude revision selection fails before mutation; existing marketplace revisions or unverified explicit origins fail instead of silently changing receipt claims.
Unknown inventory: live installation requires successful recognized JSON marketplace/plugin inventories before ownership decisions.
Exit codes: shared ProcessFailure preserves subprocess status through main; native-helper ToolError preserves scoped native failure status.
APK architecture: ELF magic, class and e_machine are checked before dynamic-library inspection; a regression fixture supplies x86 ELF bytes under ARM64 archive paths.
Harness schema: current official Claude Code docs support command plus args exec form; no unsupported-schema finding applies.

Staging resources and paths: command/prompt roots now accompany installer payload; cross-drive Windows paths use absolute-relative-path handling; maintainer dispatch is explicitly excluded from consumer payload.
Dispatch and CI: dry-run returns before worktree/log mutations; commands use argument arrays; CI version values are validated before output emission.
Limits: source review does not establish real harness installation, all-platform runnability, or an independent cross-model result; runtime execution receipts remain separate.
